testing_and_qa.data_testid_convention: Semua elemen interaktif (tombol, slider, tab, switch, chart container, badge) WAJIB menggunakan attribute data-testid dalam kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Keep tactical, left-aligned / structured grid flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp tactical button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react icons exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, glow pulses, and live data tick animations.
Use generous spacing (p-4 to p-8) and keep strict contrast ratios so tactical text on dark background remains readable.
Ensure all components are strictly implemented in React .js / .jsx format.
Ensure all data-testid attributes are preserved for automated QA testing.
